6.69 rsInvalidDefaultValueDataSetReference
rsInvalidDefaultValueDataSetReference is a critical error that will occur when a
DataSetReference.DataSetName element within a ReportParameter.DefaultValue element has a value
that does not match the name of any DataSet.
